blocks.html: Chi Foundation in partnership with Robinsons Malls and Quezon City Local Government Unit (LGU) will conduct a COVID- 19 Vaccination drive on November 20 & 21 at the 4th Level of Robinsons Galleria from 11:00 am to 5:00 pm. This activity aims to inoculate adult individuals. Interested parties should register via www.qceservices.quezoncity.gov.ph.

Buddhist Tzu Chi Foundation is an international humanitarian organization whose mission is to relieve the suffering of those in need, and create a better world for all. In Chinese, “tzu” means compassion, and “chi” relief: with open hearts and helping hands, our volunteers are here to serve you.
Robinsons Malls upholds its commitment to provide safe and accessible vaccination venues to the public, to date, it has (36) vaccination sites nationwide.
